subject: french
title: Grade 5 French — Set 2
description: Introductions, days of the week, school, and weather

questions.question: What does 'je m'appelle' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Je m'appelle' literally means 'I call myself' — used to say your name.

questions.question: How do you say 'school' in French?
What does 'lundi' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Lundi' means Monday. The French days: lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi, dimanche.

questions.question: How do you say 'I speak French'?
questions.explanation: 'Je parle français' = I speak French. Je = I, parle = speak (first person present).

questions.question: What does 'il fait beau' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Il fait beau' means the weather is nice/sunny. 'Il pleut' = it rains, 'il fait froid' = it is cold.
